svg.title: C4 Component Diagram for the protected command path inside IDEA Server
svg.desc: A use-case coordinator invokes only the product-state owner Modules declared for a protected command. A named cross-Module operation may involve more than one owner. Controlled Product Data, Product Structure and Lifecycle Governance are possible owners. Each called owner requests an authorization decision from Access Policy before a protected write. Access Policy reads account eligibility from Identity and Accounts and Project membership from Project Governance. Access Policy returns a decision but never writes product state. The arrows are permitted logical calls, not a time sequence.

span.p:
Use-case Transaction Coordinator
[Module]
Calls only the owner Interfaces declared
for one named operation

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controlled Product Data
[Module]
Owns Documents, Generations,
Checkout and Check-in

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Product Structure
[Module]
Owns Structure Snapshots and BOM

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Lifecycle Governance
[Module]
Owns Workflow, Review and Release

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Access Policy
[Module]
Returns an allow or deny decision;
never writes product state

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Identity and Accounts
[Module]
Account status and eligibility

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Project Governance
[Module]
Project, Group and membership facts

div.style: color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Owner rule: every called owner remains responsible for its own state; owner state, outcome and Audit Evidence commit together.
Legend: grey = coordinator · blue = owner · yellow = policy or fact provider · arrow = permitted logical call, not elapsed time.
